name: kafka
description: The operations for managing an Amazon MSK cluster.

subcommands.name: batch-associate-scram-secret
subcommands.description: Associates one or more Scram Secrets with an Amazon MSK cluster.

subcommands.name: batch-disassociate-scram-secret
subcommands.description: Disassociates one or more Scram Secrets from an Amazon MSK cluster.

subcommands.name: create-channel
subcommands.description: Creates a Channel that streams records from an Amazon MSK Express cluster topic to Amazon S3 or Apache Iceberg.

subcommands.name: create-cluster
subcommands.description: Creates a new MSK cluster.

subcommands.name: create-cluster-v2
subcommands.description: Creates a new MSK cluster.

subcommands.name: create-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a new MSK configuration.

subcommands.name: create-replicator
subcommands.description: Creates the replicator.

subcommands.name: create-topic
subcommands.description: Creates a topic in the specified MSK cluster.

subcommands.name: create-vpc-connection
subcommands.description: Creates a new MSK VPC connection.

subcommands.name: delete-channel
subcommands.description: Deletes the channel specified by channelArn from the cluster specified by clusterArn.

subcommands.name: delete-cluster
subcommands.description: Deletes the MSK cluster specified by the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the request.

subcommands.name: delete-cluster-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the MSK cluster policy specified by the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the request.

subcommands.name: delete-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes an MSK Configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-replicator
subcommands.description: Deletes a replicator.

subcommands.name: delete-topic
subcommands.description: Deletes a topic in the specified MSK cluster.

subcommands.name: delete-vpc-connection
subcommands.description: Deletes a MSK VPC connection.

subcommands.name: describe-channel
subcommands.description: Returns the current configuration and state of a channel.

subcommands.name: describe-cluster
subcommands.description: Returns a description of the MSK cluster whose Amazon Resource Name (ARN) is specified in the request.

subcommands.name: describe-cluster-operation
subcommands.description: Returns a description of the cluster operation specified by the ARN.

subcommands.name: describe-cluster-operation-v2
subcommands.description: Returns a description of the cluster operation specified by the ARN.

subcommands.name: describe-cluster-v2
subcommands.description: Returns a description of the MSK cluster whose Amazon Resource Name (ARN) is specified in the request.

subcommands.name: describe-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns a description of this MSK configuration.

subcommands.name: describe-configuration-revision
subcommands.description: Returns a description of this revision of the configuration.

subcommands.name: describe-replicator
subcommands.description: Describes a replicator.

subcommands.name: describe-topic
subcommands.description: Returns topic details of this topic on a MSK cluster.

subcommands.name: describe-topic-partitions
subcommands.description: Returns partition details of this topic on a MSK cluster.

subcommands.name: describe-vpc-connection
subcommands.description: Returns a description of this MSK VPC connection.

subcommands.name: get-bootstrap-brokers
subcommands.description: A list of brokers that a client application can use to bootstrap.

subcommands.name: get-cluster-policy
subcommands.description: Get the MSK cluster policy specified by the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the request.

subcommands.name: get-compatible-kafka-versions
subcommands.description: Gets the Apache Kafka versions to which you can update the MSK cluster.

subcommands.name: list-channels
subcommands.description: Returns the list of channels in a cluster.

subcommands.name: list-client-vpc-connections
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all the VPC connections in this Region.

subcommands.name: list-cluster-operations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all the operations that have been performed on the specified MSK cluster.

subcommands.name: list-cluster-operations-v2
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all the operations that have been performed on the specified MSK cluster.

subcommands.name: list-clusters
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all the MSK clusters in the current Region.

subcommands.name: list-clusters-v2
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all the MSK clusters in the current Region.

subcommands.name: list-configuration-revisions
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all the MSK configurations in this Region.

subcommands.name: list-configurations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all the MSK configurations in this Region.

subcommands.name: list-kafka-versions
subcommands.description: Returns a list of Apache Kafka versions.

subcommands.name: list-nodes
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the broker nodes in the cluster.

subcommands.name: list-replicators
subcommands.description: Lists the replicators.

subcommands.name: list-scram-secrets
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the Scram Secrets associated with an Amazon MSK cluster.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the tags associated with the specified resource.

subcommands.name: list-topics
subcommands.description: List topics in a MSK cluster.

subcommands.name: list-vpc-connections
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all the VPC connections in this Region.

subcommands.name: put-cluster-policy
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the MSK cluster policy specified by the cluster Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the request.

subcommands.name: reboot-broker
subcommands.description: Reboots brokers.

subcommands.name: reject-client-vpc-connection
subcommands.description: Returns empty response.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds tags to the specified MSK resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the tags associated with the keys that are provided in the query.

subcommands.name: update-broker-count
subcommands.description: Updates the number of broker nodes in the cluster.

subcommands.name: update-broker-storage
subcommands.description: Updates the EBS storage associated with MSK brokers.

subcommands.name: update-broker-type
subcommands.description: Updates EC2 instance type.

subcommands.name: update-channel
subcommands.description: Updates the destination configuration of an existing channel.

subcommands.name: update-cluster-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the cluster with the configuration that is specified in the request body.

subcommands.name: update-cluster-kafka-version
subcommands.description: Updates the Apache Kafka version for the cluster.

subcommands.name: update-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates an MSK configuration.

subcommands.name: update-connectivity
subcommands.description: Updates the cluster's connectivity configuration.

subcommands.name: update-monitoring
subcommands.description: Updates the monitoring settings for the cluster.

subcommands.name: update-rebalancing
subcommands.description: Use this resource to update the intelligent rebalancing status of an Amazon MSK Provisioned cluster with Express brokers.

subcommands.name: update-replication-info
subcommands.description: Updates replication info of a replicator.

subcommands.name: update-security
subcommands.description: Updates the security settings for the cluster.

subcommands.name: update-storage
subcommands.description: Updates cluster broker volume size (or) sets cluster storage mode to TIERED.

subcommands.name: update-topic
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of the specified topic.
